## Objective
Make economic evaluation consume the complete candidate/opportunity/campaign lifecycle, including triggered, rejected, invalidated, expired, unfilled, and filled outcomes with reasons.

## Owning authority
- D-153 candidate population and evidence-bound evaluator requirements.
- docs/contracts/CANDIDATE_LIFECYCLE_SPEC.md
- docs/contracts/D156_EVIDENCE_ARTIFACT_STORAGE_HARDENING_SPEC.md
- Related existing issues #316 and #323.

## Change class
CONTRACT_IMPLEMENTATION

## Current state
v8-next has local opportunity, campaign, lifecycle, and rejection-safe paths, but the economic benchmark family is mostly curve-oriented. The evaluator does not yet prove that every candidate attempt and terminal reason is represented in the economic population, and a filled-only view could still hide non-traded candidates.

## Required end state
R1 — Persist one immutable identity for every candidate episode and lifecycle transition.
R2 — Include trigger, rejection, invalidation, expiry, cancellation, partial fill, and fill reasons in the evaluator input.
R3 — Reconcile candidate, campaign, order, fill, position, and cashflow populations without dropping terminal non-fills.
R4 — Produce reasoned coverage counts and explicit missingness before any metric is computed.

## Expected file / module surface
v8-next/src/v8_next/opportunities/book.py
v8-next/src/v8_next/evaluation/store.py
v8-next/src/v8_next/evaluation/outcomes.py
v8-next/src/v8_next/evaluation/family.py
v8-next/src/v8_next/app/trial.py
v8-next/tests/test_evaluation_lineage.py
v8-next/tests/test_candidate_lifecycle_evaluator.py (new)

## Verification gates
Test every lifecycle transition, terminality, duplicate prevention, candidate-to-order joins, unfilled/expired retention, population conservation, and evaluator rejection on incomplete coverage. Run real-capture integration without forcing trades.

## Required evidence artifacts
Lifecycle ledger; population lineage manifest; candidate-to-campaign/order/fill joins; terminal reason counts; coverage/reconciliation receipt; evaluator report.

## Non-goals / forbidden scope
No filled-only winner population, no synthetic candidates, no hidden filtering of rejects/expiry, no strategy tuning, and no automatic claim promotion.

### Context-completeness contract

### 11. Normative Traceability
R1 — Terminal candidate states are retained and cannot reopen. Authority: CANDIDATE_LIFECYCLE_SPEC.
R2 — Missing population coverage blocks evaluation. Authority: D-156.
R3 — Absence is not a zero outcome.

### 12. Existing Types / Interfaces to Reuse
Reuse Opportunity, Campaign, lifecycle store, outcome validators, ArtifactBinding, family registry, and existing terminal status vocabulary.

### 13. Mathematical / Semantic Invariants
I1: every candidate has one immutable identity and monotone lifecycle.
I2: submitted + rejected + expired + invalidated + pending terminal counts reconcile to the candidate population.
I3: economic curves are derived only after population coverage passes.

### 14. Canonical Failure Semantics
Missing lifecycle row -> DATA_BLOCKED.
Illegal transition -> BLOCKED.
Terminal unsubmitted evidence -> INVALID.
Incomplete coverage -> INCONCLUSIVE/UNSUPPORTED.
No claim -> NO_ECONOMIC_CLAIM.

### 15. Dependency Map
candidate detection -> lifecycle ledger -> campaign/order/fill/account joins -> population reconciliation -> evaluator -> report.

### 16. Ambiguity / OPEN_PIN Triggers
- If an owning contract or estimand is ambiguous, STOP and open an OPEN_PIN.
- If an artifact cannot be physically produced and hashed, STOP; do not substitute it.
- If the requested behavior would open protected OOS or mint authority, STOP pending explicit governance.

### References / sources / attachments
Related: #316, #323, and docs/contracts/V8_NEXT_IMPLEMENTATION_SCOPE.md §78.

### V8 guards
- [x] I will not invent a new canonical error code, ontology, or parallel interface unless an R# requirement explicitly authorizes it.
- [x] No unrelated semantic strategy change is bundled into this implementation issue.
- [x] No frozen OOS is opened unless this issue explicitly carries that authority.
- [x] If the owning contract is ambiguous, I will open/escalate an OPEN_PIN rather than invent an interpretation.
